title: On Triangulations Generated by the Largest-Angle $n$-Section Algorithm
summary: We define a mesh refinement algorithm based on the rule of dividing the largest angles of triangular elements of planar partitions in focus into $n$ equal parts, and analyse the (geometric) properties of triangulations generated by this technique. This largest-angle $n$-section rule is compared with the classical longest-edge $n$-section rule, where it is the longest edges which are split into $n$ equal parts.
